roles.title: PhD Students
roles.desc: We admit PhD students through the UTK Department of Industrial & Systems Engineering. Research assistantships are available for qualified candidates.
roles.req: Preferred background: human factors, HCI, CS, cognitive science, psychology, or systems engineering.

roles.title: DEng Students
roles.desc: The Doctor of Engineering program at UTK allows working professionals to pursue applied doctoral research. ARCS Lab welcomes DEng students with strong applied research interests.
roles.req: Professional experience in engineering, defense, manufacturing, or technology preferred.

roles.title: Undergraduate Researchers
roles.desc: UTK undergraduates in ISE, CS, or related fields are welcome to apply for part-time research positions (typically 4 hours/week) in the ARCS Lab.
roles.req: Open to motivated undergraduates with strong academic records and genuine interest in research.

lookingFor.intro: We recruit graduate students (PhD and DEng) in Industrial & Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, and Psychology. Undergraduate research opportunities are also available.

steps.title: Explore the research
steps.body: Read about the lab's research areas and recent publications to see where your interests fit.

steps.title: Email Dr. Schelble
steps.body: Send your CV, a brief statement of research interests, and any relevant publications or projects to bschelbl@utk.edu, or use the contact form.

steps.title: Apply to the program
steps.body: PhD students are admitted through the UTK Department of Industrial & Systems Engineering, and working professionals through UTK's Doctor of Engineering program.

faq.q: Is funding available for PhD students?
faq.a: Research assistantships are available for qualified PhD candidates.

faq.q: What backgrounds do you look for?
faq.a: Human factors, HCI, computer science, cognitive science, psychology, and systems engineering. We recruit graduate students in Industrial & Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, and Psychology.

faq.q: Can I join while working full time?
faq.a: Yes, through the Doctor of Engineering program at UTK, which allows working professionals to pursue applied doctoral research. Professional experience in engineering, defense, manufacturing, or technology is preferred.
Part-time research positions, typically about 4 hours per week, open to UTK undergraduates in ISE, CS, or related fields with strong academic records and a genuine interest in research.

faq.q: How soon will I hear back?
faq.a: We typically respond within 2–3 business days. For urgent inquiries, email Dr. Schelble directly at bschelbl@utk.edu.

faq.q: When should I reach out for a 2027 start?
faq.a: Answer to come from Dr. Schelble.

faq.q: Do you accept master's students or visiting researchers?
faq.a: Answer to come from Dr. Schelble.
